# Jack P. Flaherty

> Jack P. Flaherty is a keynote speaker and executive advisor who helps health-system executives and professional services partners decide on new technology when the cost of getting it wrong lands on them.

Based in Los Angeles, California. Former PwC Director. 25 years in risk and advisory, 15 of them at the Big 4. Author of The Decision Switch (Cinch & Stone Press).

## Platforms

- [Platforms](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/platforms): four platforms, keynotes of 45 to 60 minutes, live or virtual.
- [AI Governance](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/platforms#ai-governance): for the boards and executives who answer for the technology after it goes live.
- [Fear Is Not The Control](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/platforms#fear-is-not-the-control): for leaders deciding on new technology.
- [Spot The Ripple](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/platforms#spot-the-ripple): watch for the ripples of change, risk or opportunity, and act on them.
- [The Decision Switch](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/platforms#the-decision-switch): the original keynote on getting a stalled decision made.

## Advisory and workshops

- [Board and Leadership Advisory](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/advisory/board-and-leadership): who owns the technology decision, what it was for, and how the board will know it worked.
- [The Team Writes the Plan](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/workshops/the-team-writes-the-plan): an AI and automation workshop where a department team ranks what to automate first.
